Quick Quote
 Category: Hirayama HAST Chambers
 Description 
Hirayama PC-R8 Series HAST Chamber — Single-Vessel Configuration
The Hirayama PC-R8 HAST chamber is a precision Highly Accelerated Stress Test system manufactured by Hirayama Manufacturing Corporation and distributed in North America by Hastest Solutions Inc. Available in two test-chamber capacities — the PC-304R8 (34.5 L) and PC-422R8 (84.4 L) — the PC-R8 series delivers stable unsaturated and saturated HAST conditions for semiconductor package qualification, MEMS reliability, and electronic component accelerated stress testing per JEDEC JESD22-A110, IEC 60068-2-66, and JIS C 60068-2-66.
Dual-Vessel Structure for Stable Test Conditions
The PC-R8 series adopts a round-shape dual-vessel structure where the test chamber and steam generator are mechanically independent. This separation reduces mutual temperature influence between the dry-bulb test space and wet-bulb steam generator, producing more stable temperature and humidity conditions than single-vessel HAST designs while preserving the full effective area of the test chamber. The chamber interior is constructed from electrolytic-polished SUS316L stainless steel for corrosion resistance and easy decontamination between test runs.

Two Control Methods, Three Exhaust Modes
The PC-R8 supports both HUM (unsaturated) control for IEC 60068-2-66 / JIS C 60068-2-66 compliance with adjustable humidity from 65–100% RH, and STD (saturated) control for traditional 100% RH wet-saturation testing equivalent to a conventional pressure cooker. Three exhaust modes — slow cooling with humidity maintained, cooling with moisture kept, and quick exhaust — let engineers tailor post-test sample handling to specimen sensitivity.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between PC-R8 and PC-R9?
The PC-R9 series is the next-generation successor to PC-R8, adding USB data recording, remote operation software, automatic cleaning mode, EU compliance (CE/S-Mark), and China SELO approval. Both share identical chamber dimensions, temperature/humidity/pressure ranges, and IEC 60068-2-66 compliance. Choose PC-R8 for cost-optimized procurement when next-gen connectivity is not required.
What standards does the PC-R8 meet?
PC-R8 unsaturated control mode meets IEC 60068-2-66 and JIS C 60068-2-66. The chamber is also commonly used for JEDEC JESD22-A110 highly accelerated temperature/humidity stress testing.
Can the PC-R8 perform PCT (saturated) testing?
Yes. STD saturated mode maintains 100% RH from start of test, equivalent to conventional pressure-cooker test (PCT) per the older JEDEC JESD22-A102 method.
